integrity: At fixed total the Gini comparison reduces to an exact integer numerator, while Palma is an exact rational comparison of the richest household with the four poorest. Every positive ten-part integer partition through the sharp total is exhaustively checked.
scientific_limitations: Exactly ten equally weighted households, positive integer incomes, and common total. The seventeen-unit cutoff is a discrete-resolution boundary; weak-order disagreement begins earlier through ties.
title: Seventeen income units are the sharp ten-household Gini–Palma strict-reversal boundary
